disclaimers: Research does not forecast an exact price, an exact event date, or a guaranteed return.
All comparison models are data-driven research methods; no language model or paid inference API is being used.
Adaptive learning from ACTUAL future outcomes remains gated by the separate forward-only prediction ledger.
USD/SAR and USD/LKR exchange rates can change the local price even when USD gold stays unchanged.

summary.headline: Evidence-first gold intelligence — no unfounded price certainty

forecastJournal.definition: PASS means the observed later close matched the locked forecast direction. RISE > 0%, FALL < 0%; RANGE means within ±0.5% of the recorded starting close. All other settled outcomes are FAIL.
forecastJournal.horizonRule: A horizon is settled after the required number of NEW dated provider closing observations, not at a promised exact calendar time.
forecastJournal.warning: Past accuracy is not guaranteed future performance. Models are not trained on pending outcomes.

A longer recent trend is context, not a buy/sell instruction.
Higher real yields can increase the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding gold; not a mechanical price rule.
A firmer dollar often pressures USD gold; gold and dollar strength may also coexist.

watchFor.detail: May alter short-term pressure, but is not itself a price forecast.
Rising yields often challenge gold, while falling yields can be supportive.
Currency moves can counter or reinforce changes in USD gold prices.
Historical scenario ranges can widen when realized volatility increases.

reliabilityNotes: None of the tested horizons demonstrated a reliable advantage over its simple historical benchmark.
Directional pressure scores are heuristic explanations, NOT calibrated probabilities.
A 3/7/14/30-day window is a rough calendar period, not a precise event date.
SAR/LKR outcomes also depend on currency rates; spot and local jewellery prices can differ.

overallCaution: Forecasts are statistical scenarios based on past observations, not predictions of an exact price or date. If model calibration does not outperform a historical baseline, no predictive edge is claimed. FX changes can alter SAR and LKR outcomes.
alertsNotice: Directional outlook is not a trading instruction. Jewellery charges and retail margins excluded.
